questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The image formed by a plane mirror is:
questions.explanation: A plane mirror always forms a virtual, erect, and laterally inverted image of the same size as the object.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Identify the circuit diagram that shows three resistors connected in parallel.
questions.explanation: In a parallel circuit, all resistors are connected between the same two nodes, providing multiple current paths.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean physics diagram showing four options: Circuit A shows three resistors R₁, R₂, R₃ connected in parallel between two nodes (correct answer). Circuit B shows three resistors in series. Circuit C shows two in series and one in parallel. Circuit D shows two in parallel and one in series. Labels A, B, C, D. Professional circuit diagram style.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The color of light with the longest wavelength is:
questions.explanation: In the visible spectrum, Red light has the longest wavelength (~620-750 nm) and Violet has the shortest (~380-450 nm).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The number of moles in 36 g of water (H₂O) is:
questions.explanation: Molar mass of H₂O = 2(1) + 16 = 18 g/mol. Moles = 36/18 = 2.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a Noble gas?
questions.explanation: Argon (Ar) is a Noble gas belonging to Group 18. Noble gases have completely filled valence shells.

questions.explanation: The molecule shown is Acetic acid (CH₃COOH) which contains a Carboxyl group (-COOH).
questions.imagePrompt: Clean organic chemistry diagram of Acetic acid molecule (CH₃-COOH). The Carboxyl group (-COOH) is highlighted with a circle or color. Label 'Identify the functional group'. Professional chemistry style.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Rusting of iron is an example of:
questions.explanation: Rusting involves formation of iron oxide (Fe₂O₃·xH₂O), a new substance. It is an irreversible chemical change.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which organ pumps blood throughout the human body?
questions.explanation: The heart is a muscular organ that pumps blood throughout the body via the circulatory system.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Identify the type of joint shown in the diagram.
questions.explanation: The diagram shows a Ball and Socket joint (like the hip or shoulder), allowing multi-directional movement.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean biology diagram of a Ball and Socket Joint. Shows a rounded bone head (ball) fitting into a cup-shaped cavity (socket). Label both parts. Arrows indicate multi-directional movement. Example: hip joint. Professional anatomy style.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The process by which plants make their own food using sunlight is called:
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use CO₂, water, and sunlight to produce glucose and O₂.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Identify the diagram showing a plant cell.
options: Cell A (with cell wall and chloroplast)
questions.explanation: Plant cells are distinguished by having a rigid cell wall and chloroplasts, which animal cells lack.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean biology comparison diagram. Cell A: Plant cell with cell wall, chloroplasts, large central vacuole (correct). Cell B: Animal cell with no cell wall, centrioles present. Both labeled. Professional cell biology style.
